body: ENGINEERING CHECK, 14 Nov 2026 (verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-4066593, the merge of #53 = frozen commit 40665932; debug APK build 152 from the same commit; NOT the release-candidate pair; nothing is marked walked). A first count of "6" was my query counting two files that have no music-server id yet (a NULL group): not a defect.
